title: P104 shared correction-space dimension is 96–97
body:
## Result

For the fixed pooled spans in the pinned P104 fixture, this package proves an arbitrary-shared-space lower bound of 96 and gives an exact 97-dimensional witness. Therefore the minimum lies in {96, 97}.

The witness uses 97 natural correction rows and is checked over the rationals against all 104 original pooled spans. A local screen found 121 covering candidates among 686 nearby 97-row spaces. Deleting each of the 97 rows from the witness gives at most 102 covered targets; this is only a local screen and does not rule out other 96-dimensional spaces.

## Scope

This is an algebraic result for fixed pooled spans. It does not give a chronological producer, a circuit or paid-cost improvement, a new multiplication theorem, or a selected-frontier change. The remaining question is whether dimension 96 is attainable.

## Verification

- `python3 research/p104-side-correction-rank-obstruction/verify_existing_delivery_span.py` — exact rational replay and pooled-span checks passed.
- The recorded 97-row witness has direct coverage 104; the projected-coset lower-bound certificate has rank data 8 and 104 for its 96-target subset.
- `git diff --check` passed for the submitted commit.
